_comment: The setup this app was built for: Frigate 0.18 with go2rtc on a home server, three Reolink cameras and an old MacBook's webcam. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

cameras._comment: Reolink RLC-540A at the front door, has a speaker
cameras.name: Entrance

cameras._comment: Reolink Duo 2V: main stream is 5120x1552 H.265, too heavy for a phone live, so the single view uses the sub stream too
cameras.name: Basement

cameras._comment: USB webcam of the server itself, talk goes to its own speaker (TALK_LOCAL on the relay)
cameras.name: Basement (Mac)
